text_block_list.text: (Whooosh... whooosh...)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hey. Are you really coming with me? I'm 
not gonna do anything special at all, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Please don't mind me. My goal is to learn 
what "freedom" is, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"A Walk of Freedom," was it? The piece 
you're playing. Playing at a party must be 
tough~.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever. ...It's about that time, 
so I think I'll head to a cafe.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Why come here instead of Cafe?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hm? I saw the banner and felt like having 
one. You should drink one too, it's 
delicious!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I see. So your destination changed due to 
external factors.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Where should I go after finishing this 
drink~? I feel like refreshing myself, 
so... maybe there!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look, Ruby! A betta fish. It kind of 
looks like you, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...And has that managed to help satisfy 
your desire for a refreshing change of 
pace?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hm? I'm totally chilling out. That's what 
I came here to do, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
What should I do once I get out of here? 
I'm starting to miss the sunshine... Maybe 
I'll go there.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Haaah. Right now, I'm breathing with my 
whole body! Being outside really does feel 
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Why did you not change your destination 
midway this time? The reason was...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you look like you don't understand 
a single thing. Well, I guess that can't 
be helped.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Can't be helped," you say? Do you have an 
idea of what caused it?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It's simple, really. This feeling can only 
be understood by someone who wants to be 
free.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ruby. You only want to understand freedom, 
not actually become free, right? That's 
why...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, I understand now. Indeed, that 
sounds quite difficult for me."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —However.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I must fulfill it. Whether it is 
difficult or not does not even enter into 
consideration.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: My path is simply mine to fulfill.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Even if that path is covered in thorns, 
all I can do is keep walking forward.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
To remain magnificent and supreme, giving 
up on understanding is simply not an 
option.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Haha! You're quite stubborn yourself... 
But hey, that's your "freedom" too.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...That too?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yep. The very moment you choose something, 
that itself is "freedom," Ruby.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Once you've made your "free" choice, the 
rest is up to you. —I hope your 
performance goes well.

—In the dazzling party hall, an 
unwavering, straightforward melody 
resonates.

On stage at a party attended by numerous 
celebrities, Daiichi Ruby played the 
host's requested piece with utter poise 
and dignity.

I was worried because she seemed to be 
troubled over how to interpret "freedom," 
but—

text_block_list.name: Renowned Composer
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my! A completely new take on a 
"carefree stroll", without a single doubt 
or detour along the way!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I am deeply grateful, Sensei.
choice_data_list: That was 'freedom' in true you fashion.

That was a kind of "freedom" that was 
uniquely yours.

text_block_list.name: Renowned Composer
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! ...However, when themed around 
"Freedom," tunes usually tend to be light 
and upbeat. How on earth did you interpret 
it?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...That "not choosing freedom is also 
a choice of freedom."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I was taught so by a certain someone. 
Therefore, I took the liberty of 
exercising my "freedom."

After the performance ended, I gently 
jogged over to Daiichi Ruby as she 
returned.
choice_data_list:
Daiichi Ruby really is incredible, isn't 
she?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am deeply grateful. ...Though I can 
scarcely grasp your true intentions.
choice_data_list:
Because your performance made it hard to 
believe you were ever struggling.

text_block_list.text:
There is nothing Daiichi Ruby cannot do. I 
felt as though I had learned firsthand 
that she will always see things through.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
To be magnificent and supreme is my golden 
rule.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am delighted to hear that I was able to 
fulfill it.
